subject: What a Japanese Logic Pro shows for the arrange canvas, the playhead-position group and the menu bar, and what the server did with each
question: On a Logic whose UI language is Japanese, which AX reads fail, and is the cause a missing string or a wrong one?

host.note: project lpm-locale-campaign.logicx; Logic switched to Japanese with `defaults write com.apple.logic10 AppleLanguages -array ja` and relaunched

reverify.command: python3 Scripts/livekit/live_778_japanese_ax_reads_resolve.py <worktree> <head> (with LPM_EVIDENCE_ROOT exported, Logic running in Japanese)
reverify.expected: every check passes; the run refuses at its first check on any other locale
reverify.cost: ~1 min once Logic is in Japanese

method: Two release builds — the merge base and the branch — driven against the SAME running Logic minutes apart, with no change to the application between them. Each was asked for `logic_system health`, `logic_project get_regions`, and a `logic_transport goto_position` from bar 1 to bar 9. The strings each read is looking for were taken from the ja-JP arrange census of the same day.

observations.what: the three failures, and the cause of each

rows.path: AXWindow[lpm-locale-campaign - トラック]/AXGroup[トラック]/AXGroup[トラック]/AXSplitGroup/AXSplitGroup/AXScrollArea/AXGroup[トラックコンテンツ]

rows.cause: a Japanese form that Logic does not show — one character short
the detector knows English and Korean only
rows.logic_shows: ファイル / 編集 / トラック

observations.what: what each binary answered, same Logic, minutes apart

rows.get_regions: channels_exhausted — Track Content group not found (scanned 51 AXGroups)

observations.what: the generic content fallback, which stays empty
observations.breakdown: 3 menu-item titles, 4 help sentences on unrelated controls, and the explicit トラックコンテンツ group itself

conclusion: Three independent reads failed on a Japanese UI and none of them failed for the same reason as the others. One string was absent, one was present and wrong — `再生ヘッド位置` for `再生ヘッドの位置`, matched with `.exactStrict`, so a single missing character made the group unfindable and every bar/beat readback empty — and one was a menu-title set that had never learned the language. The wrong string is the more instructive of the three: an absent variant is a gap anyone can see in a diff, while a plausible translation reads as coverage and fails silently. The A/B is the evidence: the same Logic, the same minute, answered `unknown` / `channels_exhausted` / `observed: null` to one binary and `ja-JP` / `complete: true` / `observed: 9.1` to the other.
limits: One host, one build (Logic 12.3 build 6674), one project. Another Logic build may spell any of these differently.
It says nothing about the other 69 label sets #778 counts as lacking a Japanese form. Those are still unmeasured, and this record does not license writing them.

`goto_position` still reports State B here, and correctly: the request carries four components and Logic exposes two, so the readback cannot certify the whole request. The change is that a readback exists at all.
The locale detector now RECOGNISES ja-JP; `QualificationLocale` still has two cases, so a Japanese Logic remains unqualifiable. Recognising is not supporting.

The census behind the strings is navigation-free: menus were walked without opening them and the main window to depth 8. A label on a surface that walk does not reach is absent from it for that reason, not because Logic does not show it.

The live kit's own independent witness is still blind here: `Scripts/livekit/ax_region_select.swift` matches the track-content group and the region help keyword in English and Korean only, so on this Logic it finds neither `トラックコンテンツ` nor `MIDIリージョン`. That is the same class of gap in the tool that exists to be a second reader, and it is not fixed by this record's change.
